what: Case 7b's planned positive control does not actually prove recovery_merge_if_needed ran
scenario_or_breakage: The helper writes run-params with --manual-gate-b true, so the 7b jq assertion passes even if write_then_recover touches the spy but omits the recovery call; the plan's stated success-path recovery validation remains unproven
suggested_fix: Move the spy write to after a checked recovery_merge_if_needed call, for example recovery_merge_if_needed ... || return 1; : > "$spy", and adjust 7b wording to assert recovery completion rather than a merge the writer already performed
